summary: Sangrix Inc., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer filing on Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K), disclosed that holders of its senior secured convertible notes converted $3,300,000 of aggregate principal plus $209,807 of accrued interest into 2,153,257 Class A ordinary shares at a $1.63 per-share conversion price between September 30 and October 16, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. The event is a routine debt-to-equity conversion, not a special situation; watch resulting share-count dilution and any residual note overhang.
